target: Preserve the target, clock, uncertainty meaning and refusals of a two-period servicing policy request.
model: Fixed authored contexts, declared assumptions, timestamps and supplied scalar inequalities; exact finite-state reference separate.
observation_law: Deterministic generated requests. No new customer sampling, public-data fit or bank observations.
sampling_unit: One request for conformance; whole independent customer trajectory for the separate scientific argument.
method: 24 fixtures through library and CLI, each initial/restart, plus two changed-horizon conflicts; 98 calls; replay preserved exact reference separately.
assumptions: Scientific premises in request contexts are declarations, not verified truths.
The current service has no servicing estimator; policy requests must preserve unsupported/refused results.
Ordinary restart replay is tested on fresh isolated operator roots; no multi-host recovery claim.
uncertainty_claim: No new sampling-confidence or coverage claim. Supplied inequality sets are sensitivity; exact generated values are arithmetic references.
alternatives: Independent path-sum versus backward recursion and prefix change of measure
Library versus CLI and initial versus restart
Supplied versus estimated logger, fixed versus training-selected versus unknown optimum requests
Retained refusals versus unjustified numeric output
metrics: Qualification, contexts, graph marks, set topology, error and CLI exit preservation
Invocation wall, active runner wall, separate exact-reference wall, parent/child peak RSS

acceptance_rules.pass: All 98 slots and all 24 four-way parity comparisons match frozen expectations; preserved exact reference matches in full.
acceptance_rules.negative: Any scientific/semantic/transport expectation mismatch; retain all inputs and outputs.
acceptance_rules.inconclusive: An execution obstruction prevents completing the fixed suite; retain completed slots and exact recovery action.

seed_role: Fixed suite identity; no random draws

derivation_review.anchor: Author-approved bounded conformance design; scientific predecessor failures retained

successor_review.anchor: Author-approved bounded conformance design; scientific predecessor failures retained

screen_operating_characteristics: Deterministic 98-call conformance screen; no general error rate, power or empirical validity qualification.
width_and_availability_rules: Unknown/refused is unavailable, not zero or empty. Empty/disconnected/unbounded sensitivity is preserved. [-4,4] is a supplied single-policy range, not contrast confidence. Existing broad width failure remains.
fresh_data_provenance: New authored immutable boundary fixtures and isolated operator roots; preserved exact examples explicitly replayed, not called fresh qualification data.

fixtures.anchor: Exact cases, context, input artifact bodies and expected behavior

decision_chain.business: Compare assistance with ordinary collection for the original eligible cohort
decision_chain.clock: History available before action; retention then reward/next history; stop observed score at absorbing dropout
decision_chain.target: V(realized policy)-V(never-assist), independent of evaluation; no unknown optimum claim
decision_chain.information: Sufficient observable dated histories, action/retention law, policy split and feasible actions; private state and truth are not inferred from interface declarations
decision_chain.sampling: Independent whole customer trajectories; common calendar dependence is outside the restricted proof
decision_chain.identification: Consistency, exchangeability, noninformative observation and support are necessary; identical observed laws with differing values remain explicit counterexamples
decision_chain.estimation: Finite-table nuisance argument is inherited project work; no installed policy estimator is tested or fabricated
decision_chain.uncertainty: Finite-table bound is conservative and too wide in the preserved example; no P4 or general hidden-state calibration
decision_chain.numerical: Exact path/recursion/observed-prefix calculations separately reproduced; simple quadratic topology checked analytically
decision_chain.decision: Conditional generated-law reward and full-workflow planning scenarios; a consumer must preserve scientific limitations before an investment recommendation

cost_accounting.scenario: 1000 generated customers, assumed USD100/utility; contrast 5/8 gives USD62500 incremental reward; assistance already deducted.
cost_accounting.measured: Every invocation including failed/replayed requests and worker/CLI startup; active import/journal wall; exact reference wall separately; individual parent/child high-water RSS.
cost_accounting.excluded: Initial interpreter/module startup, intersegment idle, authoring/review/manuscript time, simultaneous tree memory and unexecuted workflow components.
cost_accounting.money: All currency inputs stipulated; no measured bank prices or ROI.

evidence_classes.local_execution: Frozen library/CLI behavior and exact-reference replay
evidence_classes.independent_reference: Different arithmetic formulas under generated truth; not independent institutional review
evidence_classes.contract_double: Proposed consumer prerequisites and interpretation only; no executed consumer double
evidence_classes.authentic_owner_run: Later dated cohorts, truth/design/split, real costs, owner trace and accepted disposition if justified by prototype merit

limits: No servicing policy estimator implemented in the canonical service
No general hidden-state, unknown-optimum, dependence or unbounded-reward inference
No new sampling study or coverage/useful-width acceptance; R03S negative review retained
No MCP requalification, foreign-language bridge, sibling execution or live model call
No authentic bank data, prices, independent acceptance or adoption
Restart replay is not process-kill, exactly-once or multi-host qualification
